task.outcome:
Correct golden release verification of invocation-preserving scheduler recovery commands.
Confirmed at d8543630b5a4fe4f01d695ac25b9bc89204a7245. Owner scripts/release_readiness_gate.py:1383-1405 _run_installed_path_contract_scenario. docs/UPDATES.md Confirmation refusal contract and mempalace_code/cli_commands/alias.py recovery_cli_command require the invoked launcher when PATH does not resolve the same CLI. Actual absolute CLI invocation on macOS with PATH=os.defpath: scheduler install/remove without --yes exit 2, empty stderr, JSON ok=false, stage=unsupported-platform, exit_code=2 and absolute-invoked-launcher + update status --json. Product satisfies contract; golden predicate requires literal bare mempalace-code update status --json and fails both. Control update apply without --yes emits stage confirmation and recovery ending --yes --json and passes current predicate. Previous exact installed wheel golden isolated-source run fails this verifier row. No unsafe update or scheduler mutation observed or executed.
Evidence: .codex-local/release-prep-20261002/bug-intake/reproduction.json (cli_refusals), .codex-local/release-prep-20261002/installed-golden-isolated.json. Smallest correction: verifier evaluates recovery argv against established launcher identity and action instead of one literal spelling, preserving platform, code, JSON, no-mutation and launcher safety checks. No runtime change justified by this finding.
